column1: # Test registry for scripts/db-test.sh. Columns are tab separated:
# marker: text that must appear in the test's output line, and the line must not contain FAIL.
#   (mutation gate). fail = the test detects the vulnerability. pass = it cannot,
#   so an X test marked pass needs a note saying why.
# T tests are v1.0 behaviour that the fixes must not change, so they pass on both schemas.
# A new test in smoke_test.sql must be added here, or the db-tests job fails.

positive control: an honest human proposal must keep working
positive control: own-store versions stay visible

the v1.0 trigger already rejected un-redaction
